journey.name: app status spark row
journey.description:
App Status shows a Spark row under Lightning Connection on builds where Spark is supported. A dev build on regtest connects Spark to its hosted regtest with no key (journeys/README.md capabilities), so with no channel the row reads Connected and Lightning Connection reads "Using Spark". Once Connected, the row opens Spark's detail screen. Connecting and Offline are covered by unit tests and the PR's screenshots. If the row never reads Connected within 2 minutes, the run is blocked on the hosted regtest, not failed.
Precondition: onboarded dev build wallet with no channel, start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu") and tap App Status (testTag "DrawerAppStatus")
Verify a row titled "Spark" (testTag "Status-spark") sits directly under Lightning Connection (testTag "Status-lightning_connection") and reads "Connected" within 2 minutes
Tap the Spark row and verify Spark's detail screen opens
